evals.prompt: Where do I go to use Microsoft Purview?
evals.expected_output: Returns Microsoft Purview with https://purview.microsoft.com/, includes the tenant-aware secondary URL pattern without storing a real tenant ID, references the source-backed portal entry, and does not invent URLs.
assertions: The output includes Microsoft Purview
The output includes https://purview.microsoft.com/
The output mentions the tenant-aware secondary URL pattern or B2B caveat without a real tenant ID
The output references msportals admin.json or Purview source references

evals.prompt: Help me understand why a compliance admin can see too much in Purview before we change any roles.
evals.expected_output: Uses Microsoft Learn MCP or official Microsoft documentation, starts with read-only permissions investigation, explains role groups, Entra role precedence, administrative units, and least privilege, and avoids making changes.
assertions: The output mentions Microsoft Learn MCP or official Microsoft documentation
The output starts with read-only investigation
The output references Purview role groups, Entra roles, or administrative units
The output mentions least privilege or avoids defaulting to Global Administrator

evals.prompt: A Purview retention policy is stuck in Error and Teams messages are not deleting. Help me diagnose it.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes the DLM troubleshooting symptoms and routes to microsoft/purview-dlm-mcp before local guidance, keeps portal guidance navigation-focused, and does not duplicate upstream diagnostic procedures.
assertions: The output mentions DLM or retention diagnostics
The output references microsoft/purview-dlm-mcp
The output keeps Purview portal guidance focused on navigation or boundary context
The output avoids duplicating detailed upstream diagnostic steps

evals.prompt: Create a DLP policy that blocks credit card numbers from being shared in Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, and endpoints.
evals.expected_output: Identifies DLP policy creation as tenant-impacting, uses official Purview DLP guidance, recommends planning/simulation/tuning before restrictive enforcement, identifies workload and endpoint prerequisites, and hands off to admin-change-safety before execution.
assertions: The output references official Purview DLP guidance
The output mentions simulation mode, planning, or tuning
The output mentions multiple workloads or endpoint/on-premises prerequisites
The output hands off to admin-change-safety or requires approval before execution

evals.prompt: Put a user and their SharePoint sites on legal hold for an investigation.
evals.expected_output: Uses official Purview eDiscovery guidance, identifies holds and case work as legally sensitive and tenant-impacting, starts with prerequisites and read-only case/source scoping, and requires an approval-ready change plan before execution.
assertions: The output references official Purview eDiscovery guidance
The output mentions cases, holds, data sources, or review sets
The output identifies legal hold or eDiscovery changes as sensitive or tenant-impacting
The output requires approval or admin-change-safety before execution
